Bill.BriefDescription: Reaffirming that households may collect rainwater without a water right.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to rainwater harvesting; adding a new section tochapter 90.03 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: On October 12, 2009, the department ofecology issued an interpretive policy statement clarifying that a waterright is not required for rooftop rainwater harvesting. It is theintent of legislature to reaffirm that households may collect rainwaterwithout a water right.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 90.03 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The definition of "water resources" in RCW 43.27A.020 is notintended to mean or imply that the water appropriation permitrequirements of this chapter apply to the capture, storage, and use ofrainwater if the water is collected from the roof of a building and isused on the same land parcel on which it was captured or if rainwateris captured and used for watering livestock or wildlife using a guzzlermechanism. The department may prohibit new systems for the capture, p. 1 HB 3164storage, and use of rainwater in a specific locality if it isdetermined that existing water rights or streamflows would be impaired. (2) Any person who believes that existing or proposed projects tocapture, store, and use rainwater are impairing or would impair theirwater right may file a declaratory judgment action in a court ofcompetent jurisdiction for a determination of whether the rainwaterproject or projects are having such an effect. The court may prescribesuch remedies as it deems equitable. (3) For the purposes of this section, a roof must be part of afixed structure constructed above the ground, the primary purpose ofwhich is to provide shelter to people, animals, or materials. (4) For the purposes of this section, a guzzler is a raincollection device intended to capture and store rainwater to supplyanimals with drinking water.
